body.heading: What it does
paragraphs: A small business gets messages and comments on several platforms at once and misses half of them. The unified inbox gathers them into one list, filtered by platform and status, with a reply drafted by AI from the brand's Playbook ready to edit and send.

body.heading: Under my review
paragraphs: As CTO I review every change to Uri's code. Where a colleague built a part, they built it under my review and supervision. I also led the revamp of the interface and fixed most of the bugs. Uri began as Uri Creative in November 2025, and this product grew out of that work.
